name: jei-transfer
description: JEI '+' recipe transfer on each BuildCraft transfer handler: Assembly Table (real items), Auto Workbench (phantom blueprint) and Distiller (buckets). JEI ignores the bridge's key injection, so recipe pages open from each GUI's click area and '+' is clicked by position (GUI scale 2, 427x240 screen).

steps.label: click the power bar (JEI click area)

steps.name: asm-jei
steps.look: JEI Assembly Table page 1: redstone + diamond -> diamond chipset, with a '+' button bottom-right

steps.name: asm-after-transfer
steps.look: back on the Assembly Table: one redstone and one diamond moved into the input grid, the hotbar stacks show 63

steps.label: click the progress arrow (JEI click area)

steps.name: awb-jei
steps.look: JEI Crafting page 1 with a '+' beside the first recipe

steps.name: awb-after-transfer
steps.look: back on the Auto Workbench: the blueprint grid shows the first recipe's pattern as phantom items

steps.label: click the process schematic (JEI click area)

steps.name: dist-jei
steps.look: JEI Distiller page 1: oil in, two fractions out, '+' bottom-right

steps.name: dist-after-transfer
steps.look: back on the Distiller: one oil bucket went into the machine (the hotbar holds one fewer; the tile drains it into the input tank and leaves an empty bucket in its slot)
